findings.explanation: The catalog lists Splunkbase 1352 as 'App for Cisco Network Data' (cisco_ios), not a Cisco Security add-on, and it has nothing to do with Meraki MT or Cisco Spaces sensors.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove it or replace it with the Spaces Add-On for Splunk (8485) and the Meraki add-on (5580) as appropriate.

findings.explanation: The SPL hard-codes one global temperature and humidity band (16 to 28 C and 20 to 70 percent), so cold-storage sensors alarm constantly and server rooms are not held to 18-27 C. Description lists only temperature and humidity while the SPL also tests PM2.5, CO2, TVOC and water.
findings.quote: Define location-specific thresholds (server rooms: 18-27°C; offices: 20-24°C; cold storage: 2-8°C).
findings.suggested_fix: Say the SPL uses one default band and show how to use a per-location lookup.

findings.explanation: A fixed PM2.5, CO2 and TVOC threshold does not prove health-standard compliance, and the 16-28 C band does not prove cold-chain compliance either.
findings.quote: ensures office air quality meets health standards
findings.suggested_fix: Describe the alerts as threshold breaches only; leave out compliance wording.

findings.explanation: Battery life and storage claims differ by MT model and are not sourced; also check that sourcetype cisco:spaces:sensors and the fields temperature, pm25, co2, tvoc and waterDetected exist in the Spaces add-on.
findings.quote: MT sensors have five-year battery life and five days of onboard data storage.
findings.suggested_fix: Check the Meraki MT datasheets and the add-on's sourcetype documentation; drop or source the figures.

findings.explanation: The SPL keeps only readings that breached a threshold, so healthy sensors and the full trend are not in the result.
findings.quote: Gauge panels (current temp/humidity per zone), Line chart (environmental trends over 7 days)
findings.suggested_fix: Use a separate trend search or limit the visualization to the alert table.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: case() stops at the first matching condition, so a water leak or high CO2 on a reading that also has high temperature is not reported; latest() after the filter returns the latest alerting reading, not the current one.

summary: The sensor coverage and hardware list read well, but the thresholds in the SPL do not match the location-specific ranges in the prose, compliance-style claims exceed the search, and one reference names the wrong add-on.
